My heart aches for all survivors of abuse, starting with women.

But please don't forget that there are men out there who have also been devastated. By men and women. #metoo #churchtoo

https://t.co/K5cdiAx9lO

What emboldens me? Gives me courage?

The Weinstein and #MeToo survivors.

The MSU survivors.

Most of all, the image of Christ riding into Jerusalem to a known and certain death.

If Christ can do that, I can also do what needs to be done.
